name: Jellyfin YouTube Plugin
description: Stream YouTube videos as Jellyfin Series without downloading them. Uses .strm files + local stream proxy + yt-dlp + YoutubeExplode.
overview: Add YouTube channels and stream their videos directly as Series in Jellyfin. No download to disk. No YouTube Data API key required - uses yt-dlp for all metadata. SQLite database isolated from Jellyfin's main DB. Configurable polling per channel and retention policies.

versions.changelog:
- FIX: plugin now loads correctly - NuGet dependencies (YoutubeExplode, Microsoft.Data.Sqlite, SQLitePCLRaw) bundled in the zip
- Removed YouTube Data API v3 dependency - uses yt-dlp --flat-playlist for channel metadata (no API key, no quota)
- Removed Quartz - uses System.Threading.Timer (built-in .NET)
- Removed Polly - simple try/catch
- Channel list stored in PluginConfiguration.Channels (UI-managed)
- WatchedTracker subscribed to ISessionManager.PlaybackStopped
- YoutubeExplode primary stream resolver + yt-dlp fallback

- Configuration page now functional via Jellyfin's built-in plugin config endpoints
- YoutubeExplode as primary resolver (no external binary needed)
- yt-dlp fallback when YoutubeExplode fails (e.g. age-restricted content)
- WatchedTracker subscribed to ISessionManager.PlaybackStopped events
- Channels stored in PluginConfiguration (UI-managed)
- Test resolver button in diagnostics
- Max quality selector (144p-4K)
- Auto-reload scheduler when channels added/removed via UI
- Initial scaffold: plugin entry point, configuration page, SQLite store, channel sync skeleton, .strm generator, stream proxy skeleton, watched tracker
